rationale: Ground truth is thin (essentially 'LGTM' plus a request to split out the VoxCPM2 regression fix into a separate PR) for a trivial 2-line seed removal. X stays appropriately scoped, grounds every claim in quoted diff/file evidence, and directly confirms the one real reviewer concern (VoxCPM2 tracked separately, out of scope). Y produces a much longer, more actionable-looking review with concrete patches, but it hinges on an enormous number of unverifiable hyper-specific claims (exact line numbers across unrelated vLLM internals, a fabricated 3-PR seed history, doc line citations) for a PR the actual reviewers rubber-stamped, and never engages the VoxCPM2 scoping concern at all — a major groundedness and recall risk despite its polished format.
